name: B10-0570/2025 (The Left) – Continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on repeated incidents where balloons and other unmanned devices crossed from Belarus into Lithuania, disrupting flights. It expresses support for Lithuania and its right to defend its airspace. It asks Belarus to help clarify what happened, calls for an independent international investigation led by the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe, and warns that emergency measures must not become a permanent limit on people's rights, including the right to seek asylum.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- Lithuania, Belarus and people living near their shared border are affected.
- Next, the resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and the Belarusian government; nothing happens automatically.
